topic: DIDs Internal Parameter Data Identifiers for Side Position Light Control Reasons
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific internal parameter data identifier (DID) related to the reasons for opening or closing side position lights.

column_semantics.Short Name: The short name of the DID, which uniquely identifies the parameter.
column_semantics.Description: A brief description of the DID's purpose in Chinese.
column_semantics.Value Table: A list of hexadecimal values and their corresponding meanings for the DID.
column_semantics.Default: The default value of the DID.
column_semantics.Remark: Additional information about the DID, such as storage behavior or significance.
column_semantics.ECU: The Electronic Control Unit responsible for this DID.

core_entities.name: SidePosnLghtOpenCtrlRsn
core_entities.description: Identifies the reason for opening the side position light.

core_entities.name: SidePosnLghtClsCtrlRsn
core_entities.description: Identifies the reason for closing the side position light.

core_conditions.name: SOARequestOn
core_conditions.description: Signal indicating a request from the Smart Operating Area (SOA).

core_conditions.name: DippedBeamLightSwitchOn
core_conditions.description: Signal indicating the dipped beam light switch is on.

core_conditions.name: FrontFogLightSwitchOn
core_conditions.description: Signal indicating the front fog light switch is on.

core_conditions.name: RearFogLightSwitchOn
core_conditions.description: Signal indicating the rear fog light switch is on.

core_conditions.name: AutoLightRequestOn
core_conditions.description: Signal indicating an automatic lighting request is on.

core_conditions.name: UsageModeDissatisfaction
core_conditions.description: Indicates dissatisfaction with the current usage mode.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the internal parameters used by the LHZ CU ECU to track and store the reasons for opening and closing side position lights. It can be used to verify that the ECU correctly logs and stores the most recent 10 reasons for these actions, ensuring proper diagnostic and maintenance functionality.
